news_candidates.title: Yen soars as Bank of Japan tipped to raise interest rates
news_candidates.title_zh: 市场预期日本央行加息，日元大涨
news_candidates.summary: Jump lifts currency to highest level against dollar in a month, while global markets remain jittery Business live – latest updates The Japanese yen has soared by more than 2% against the dollar amid speculation the Bank of Japan is set to raise interest rates. The latest jump on Thursday lifted the yen to its highest level against the dollar in a month, at 155.57, and followed a 0.9% move the previous day. Continue reading...
news_candidates.summary_zh: 市场猜测日本央行将加息，日元兑美元上涨逾2%，升至一个月高点155.57。全球市场仍保持紧张。

news_candidates.title: SoftBank Group Prices ¥1 Trillion Retail Bond at 4.75%
news_candidates.title_zh: 软银集团以4.75%票息发行1万亿日元零售债券
news_candidates.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. priced a ¥1 trillion ($6.3 billion) retail bond with a coupon of 4.75%, as higher rates boost the appeal of bonds, potentially drawing more companies to retail funding.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 软银集团发行1万亿日元、约合63亿美元的零售债券，票息为4.75%。较高利率提升了债券吸引力，可能促使更多企业转向零售融资。

news_candidates.title: ValueEdge Chair: SpaceX Needs A Succession Plan
news_candidates.title_zh: ValueEdge主席：SpaceX需要继任计划
news_candidates.summary: Nell Minow, Chair of ValueEdge Advisors, says Anthropic is moving in the opposite direction from SpaceX on governance, but argues its structure is still unusual and potentially problematic. She says the company is combining elements of public companies and nonprofits, including a public benefit corporation framework that she says both cares about shareholder value and does not. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: ValueEdge Advisors主席内尔·米诺称，Anthropic在治理方面与SpaceX走向相反，但其结构仍不寻常且可能存在问题。她称该公司结合了上市公司和非营利组织的元素。

news_candidates.title: Carney claps back at Lutnick, says Canada will resume trade talks 'when the Americans are ready'
news_candidates.title_zh: 加拿大称将继续对等反制美国关税
news_candidates.summary: Canada has retaliated against President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs with "dollar for dollar" duties on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 加拿大表示将在美国准备好后恢复贸易谈判，并称已针对特朗普政府的50%关税采取“逐美元”反制措施，相关关税下周生效。

news_candidates.title: Skyworks Chair: It Will Be a While Before This Cycle Ends
news_candidates.title_zh: Skyworks董事长：本轮周期结束尚需时日
news_candidates.summary: Chris King, Chairman of Skyworks Solutions, is introduced as a semiconductor industry veteran with more than 50 years of experience. The segment highlights her time at IBM, her role as the first female CEO of a chip company at AMI Semiconductor, and that company’s later acquisition by Onsemi. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Skyworks Solutions董事长克里斯·金拥有逾50年半导体行业经验。报道介绍了她在IBM的经历、担任AMI Semiconductor首位女性CEO，以及该公司后来被安森美收购。

news_candidates.title: Ciena CEO: We’re a Critical Enabler of AI Infrastructure
news_candidates.title_zh: Ciena业绩超预期并上调指引，强调AI基础设施需求
news_candidates.summary: Gary Smith, CEO and President of Ciena, discusses a strong earnings report that beat expectations and raised guidance. Despite the positive quarterly results, the company’s shares are falling sharply, prompting the host to ask Smith what investors may be overlooking. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Ciena公布强劲季度业绩，超过预期并上调指引。CEO称公司是AI基础设施的关键赋能者，但公司股价当日明显下跌。

news_candidates.title: Los Angeles Schools Ban Student Use of AI Tools on District Devices
news_candidates.title_zh: 洛杉矶学校禁止学生在学区设备上使用AI工具
news_candidates.summary: The Los Angeles Unified School District is barring students from using generative AI tools on district devices as part of a broader push to reduce screen time in the classroom.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 洛杉矶联合学区禁止学生在学区设备上使用生成式AI工具，此举是减少课堂屏幕使用时间的更广泛行动之一。

news_candidates.title: Adobe Names Chakravarthy CEO, While Other Contender Departs
news_candidates.title_zh: Adobe任命Anil Chakravarthy为下一任CEO
news_candidates.summary: Adobe Inc. named Anil Chakravarthy, the leader of its marketing and analytics software business, as its next chief executive officer, thrusting the company veteran into a challenging competition with artificial intelligence upstarts.
news_candidates.summary_zh: Adobe任命营销与分析软件业务负责人Anil Chakravarthy为下一任CEO，接任者将面对AI初创公司带来的竞争压力。

news_candidates.title: T-Mobile CEO Gopalan Looks to Internet, AI for Growth
news_candidates.title_zh: T-Mobile首席执行官戈帕兰寻求通过互联网和AI实现增长
news_candidates.summary: As he nears his one-year anniversary as T-Mobile US Inc.’s chief executive officer, Srini Gopalan is counting on growth in businesses such as home internet and artificial intelligence to help buoy a languishing share price.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 在担任T-Mobile美国公司首席执行官即将满一年之际，斯里尼·戈帕兰寄望家庭互联网和人工智能等业务增长，以提振低迷的股价。

news_candidates.title: Trump’s 100% tariff on drones will be disaster for the US, critics warn
news_candidates.title_zh: 特朗普对无人机征收100%关税引发美国供应风险担忧
news_candidates.summary: Americans fear there are no cheap alternatives as tariffs suddenly hit drones.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美国对无人机征收100%关税后，批评者警告美国市场缺乏廉价替代品。该政策将直接影响无人机进口成本及相关美国用户和企业。

news_candidates.title: 'I lost my savings after a job interview scam'
news_candidates.title_zh: “我因求职面试骗局失去了积蓄”
news_candidates.summary: Job seekers, especially Gen Z, are being targeted with fake, booby-trapped recruitment apps.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 求职者，尤其是Z世代，正成为虚假且暗藏陷阱的招聘应用程序的目标。

news_candidates.title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
news_candidates.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra模型，称进入AGI时代
news_candidates.summary: OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. As OpenAI announced earlier this week, it's also the first model designated as meeting OpenAI's "critical cybersecurity capability threshold" - but the company promises that won't […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra，称其在网络安全、专业工作、软件工程、科学和计算机操作等领域实现代际能力提升。

news_candidates.title: NASA to Cover Progress 96 Spacecraft Launch, Docking
news_candidates.title_zh: NASA将直播进步96号飞船发射与对接
news_candidates.summary: NASA will provide live coverage of the launch and docking of a Roscosmos cargo spacecraft carrying about three tons of food, fuel, and supplies for the crew aboard the International Space Station. The unpiloted Progress 96 resupply spacecraft is scheduled to launch at 12:15 p.m. EDT (9:15 p.m. Baikonur time), Wednesday, Sept. 9, on a […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: NASA将直播俄罗斯航天局货运飞船的发射和对接。该飞船将向国际空间站乘组运送约3吨食品、燃料和物资；无人进步96号补给飞船计划于9月9日发射。

news_candidates.title: Is India's internet boom running into an undersea problem?
news_candidates.title_zh: 印度互联网繁荣是否正遭遇海底问题？
news_candidates.summary: At least 13 of India's 18 intercontinental cables come ashore within six kilometres of Mumbai's Versova beach.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度18条洲际海底电缆中，至少13条在孟买韦尔索瓦海滩六码范围内登陆。

news_candidates.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
news_candidates.title_zh: 猪肾移植在美国男子体内工作创纪录271天
news_candidates.summary: A man has lived for a record nine months with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human transplant.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 一名男子在等待人类肾脏移植期间，带着移植的猪肾存活创纪录的九个月。

news_candidates.title: Microsoft opens up Xbox Cloud Gaming with new pay-as-you-go option
news_candidates.title_zh: 微软为Xbox云游戏推出新的按次付费选项
news_candidates.summary: Microsoft says it will let anyone access Xbox Cloud Gaming in November, without the need to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass. The change to a pay-as-you-go model is part of some sweeping changes to Xbox Cloud Gaming today, and is designed for people who don't use cloud access enough to warrant a monthly subscription. "Players […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: 微软称，任何人从11月起均可使用Xbox云游戏，无需订阅Xbox Game Pass。改为按次付费模式是该服务一系列重大调整的一部分，面向云游戏使用频率不足以订阅月费的用户。

news_candidates.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 4988-4994: More New Tricks for an Old Dog
news_candidates.title_zh: 好奇号博客，第4988至4994火星日：老狗的新把戏
news_candidates.summary: Written by Michelle Minitti, MAHLI Deputy Principal Investigator Earth planning date: Friday, Aug. 21, 2026 After Curiosity’s 14 years on the surface, Mars continues to surprise. Both of our workspaces this week contained features unlike quite anything we have seen in the past — broad, shallow pits (like the one in the image above) dotted […]
news_candidates.summary_zh: 在火星表面运行14年后，好奇号仍不断遇到惊喜。本周两个工作区都出现了此前少见的地貌特征，包括散布着凹点的宽阔浅坑。

news_candidates.title: From cake to pizza: How to get the best birthday freebies (and why there's a catch)
news_candidates.title_zh: 从蛋糕到披萨：如何获得最佳生日免费赠品及其限制
news_candidates.summary: Cake, coffee, make-up and burgers are just some of the free things you can get on your birthday.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 生日当天可免费获得的物品包括蛋糕、咖啡、化妆品和汉堡等，但这些优惠也存在限制。

news_candidates.title: Oura files to go public
news_candidates.title_zh: Oura提交上市申请
news_candidates.summary: The ring maker says that its business has shown significant revenue growth over the past year.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 这家智能戒指制造商称，其业务在过去一年实现显著营收增长。
